text: 近期，ETF规模持续回升，千亿级产品阵营再度扩容。Wind数据显示，截至10月21日收盘，全市场规模超过千亿元的ETF共有5只。具体来看，沪深300ETF华泰柏瑞估算规模达1242.04亿元，银华日利ETF估算规模达1211.6亿元，科创50ETF华夏估算规模达1045.4亿元，黄金ETF华安估算规模达1030.42亿元，华宝添益ETF估算规模达1030.01亿元。
text_en: Recently, ETF scale has continued to recover, and the ranks of products with over RMB 100 billion have expanded again. Wind data show that as of the close on October 21, there were 5 ETFs in the whole market with scale exceeding RMB 100 billion. Specifically, the estimated scale of Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF reached RMB 124.204 billion, the estimated scale of Yinhua Rili ETF reached RMB 121.16 billion, the estimated scale of ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF reached RMB 104.54 billion, the estimated scale of Huaan Gold ETF reached RMB 103.042 billion, and the estimated scale of Huabao Tianyi ETF reached RMB 103.001 billion.
